issues.expected: The ReadytoCook Cancel behavior cancels or updates cooking time.
issues.observed: The exact Cancel carrier transition:line:27 has an empty effects list.
issues.reason: The endpoint contract is satisfied by the exact ReadytoCook-to-DoorShutWithItem Cancel transition, but the independent effect requirement is not represented on that carrier. The issue is confined to the effect property.
issues.requirement_quote: canceling or updating the cooking time.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The effect may be implicit in an unexposed runtime mechanism; the supplied FCSTM has no declared alternative effect or variable carrier.
issues.title: ReadytoCook Cancel behavior lacks the required effect

issues.basis: The exact Cooking-to-DoorOpenWithItem transition is transition:line:30 with trigger Door_Opened and effects []. The corresponding source transition is source:transition:tr_0014, linked by the supplied source trace and working-contract mapping.
issues.expected: The Cooking door-open behavior stops the timer.
issues.observed: Transition transition:line:30 carries Door_Opened but has no effect.
issues.reason: The contract requires an effect associated with the Cooking door-open behavior, but the exact closed transition carrier has an empty effects list. The endpoint itself is present and is not treated as the effect obligation.
issues.requirement_quote: opening the door stops the timer
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The timer may be modeled outside transition effects, but no supplied closed-model artifact identifies another exact carrier.
issues.title: Cooking door-open timer-stop effect is not represented
